_note: Entrance verse pool — intense bhāva and prema only, from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's Śikṣāṣṭakam, the Six Gosvāmīs, and the ācāryas of the paramparā, in the translations Śrīla Prabhupāda gave and quoted. No Bhagavad-gītā verses. One is chosen at random on every load. Citations checked against Vedabase.io; please give them one final read before this ships.

quotes.text: O my Lord, when will my eyes be decorated with tears of love flowing constantly when I chant Your holy name?
When will my voice choke up, and when will the hairs of my body stand on end at the recitation of Your name?
O Govinda! Feeling Your separation, I am considering a moment to be like twelve years.
I know no one but Kṛṣṇa as my Lord, and He shall remain so even if He handles me roughly by His embrace, or makes me brokenhearted by not being present before me.
I do not want wealth, followers, or beautiful women. I only want Your causeless devotional service, birth after birth.
One should chant the holy name in a humble state of mind, thinking oneself lower than the straw in the street — in such a state of mind one can chant the holy name constantly.
Glory to the chanting of the holy name, which cleanses the mirror of the heart and extinguishes the fire of material existence, expanding the ocean of transcendental bliss.
O most munificent incarnation! You are Kṛṣṇa Himself, and You are widely distributing pure love of Kṛṣṇa. We offer our respectful obeisances unto You.
Kaivalya, oneness in the effulgence of Brahman, appears hellish to the devotee who has received the merciful sidelong glance of Lord Gaura.
O My Lord! O most merciful master! O master of Mathurā! When shall I see You again? Because of not seeing You, My agitated heart has become unsteady.
My dear friend, if you are indeed attached to your worldly friends, do not look at the smiling face of Lord Govinda as He stands on the bank of the Yamunā at Keśīghāṭa.
quotes.source: Quoted by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu · Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 5.224

quotes.text: Love of Godhead is dormant in everyone's heart. It has only to be awakened by the process of hearing and chanting.
When love of Godhead awakens in the heart, liberation herself stands before the devotee with folded hands, waiting to render service.
quotes.source: Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura · Śrī Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, quoted by Śrīla Prabhupāda

quotes.text: O Lord Hari, I have wasted my life. Having obtained a human birth, I did not worship Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
When shall the day be mine when my body will tremble and tears will flow at the mere utterance of Your name?
